name: Andrew Young
desc: American politician, diplomat, activist and pastor

offices.t: United States Ambassador to the United Nations

summary: Andrew Jackson Young Jr. (born March 12, 1932) is an American politician, diplomat, and activist. Beginning his career as a pastor, Young was an early leader in the civil rights movement, serving as executive director of the Southern Christian Leadership Conference (SCLC) and as a close confidant to Martin Luther King Jr.
